# Site Builder Reference

For creating and maintaining a site with CfA Static. Regenerate with `npm run generate-references`, or `npm run generate-developer-reference` for this file alone.

## Runtime And Commands

Use Node `>=22` and npm. Install dependencies from the repository root:

```sh
npm install
```

Selected site-building commands from [package.json](../package.json). See [verification](../skills/cfa-static-site-builder/references/verification.md) for which checks to run.

| Command | Package Script |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run serve` | `rm -rf _site && node scripts/eleventy-build.js --serve --incremental` |
| `npm run build` | `rm -rf _site && node scripts/eleventy-build.js && npm run check:links` |
| `npm run customise-cms` | `node scripts/customise-cms/index.js` |
| `npm run check:links` | `node scripts/check-internal-links.js _site` |
| `npm run check:a11y` | `node scripts/check-accessibility.js _site` |
| `npm run lint:scss` | `npx stylelint "src/css/**/*.scss"` |
| `npm run test` | `node ./test/run-tests.js` |
| `npm run generate-references` | `npm run generate-blocks-reference && npm run generate-pages-yml && npm run generate-developer-reference` |

## CMS Choices

These are available editor options, not this site's saved selection. CMS collection choices do not control what Eleventy publishes. See [project setup](../skills/cfa-static-site-builder/references/project-setup.md#choose-collections-and-cms-features) before changing them.

| Collection | Content Directory | Availability | Depends On |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pages` | `src/pages` | Required | None |
| `news` | `src/news` | Optional | None |
| `guide-categories` | `src/guide-categories` | Optional | None |
| `guide-pages` | `src/guide-pages` | Optional | `guide-categories` |
| `snippets` | `src/snippets` | Required | None |

| Feature | Editor Choice |
| --- | --- |
| `permalinks` | Do you want custom permalinks on items? |
| `redirects` | Do you want redirect\_from support (for URL redirects)? |
| `faqs` | Do you want FAQs on items? |
| `galleries` | Do you want image galleries on items? |
| `external_navigation_urls` | Do you want to link to external URLs in your navigation? |
| `use_visual_editor` | Do you want to use a visual rich-text editor instead of markdown? |
| `no_index` | Do you want to hide pages/news from listings (no\_index field)? |

## Themes

Edit [theme.scss](../src/css/theme.scss), browse the theme files in [src/css](../src/css/), or preview and export a theme at `/theme-editor/` on the running site.

Consult the [Sass defaults](../src/css/_variables.scss) and [breakpoints](../src/css/_breakpoints.scss) rather than copying their values into another reference. Prefer theme overrides over changes to core styles.
